# XOR and XNOR

Source: [4833](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4833); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4833-n1"></a>

- Documented boolean XOR shortcut is A != B; boolean XNOR is A == B.

Source limitations:

- Source omits that this shortcut assumes boolean-valued operands; Workshop's cross-type comparison behavior in article 7978 makes unrestricted use unsafe.
